verdict_label: Use chin or open hand instead
explanation: Pointing at a person with a single index finger is traditionally considered rude in India; many people instead point with the chin, an open hand, or the whole hand. Pointing with two fingers is sometimes reserved specifically for addressing someone considered inferior, underscoring why single-finger pointing reads as commanding rather than neutral.
local_tip: Gesture with an open hand or a slight chin-tilt to indicate a direction or person, rather than pointing with one finger.

also_check.note: Pointing with the index finger is considered impolite; gesturing with an open hand is preferred.
Pointing with the index finger is seen as impolite; the thumb is commonly used instead.
Pointing with the index finger is common and unremarkable in most casual contexts.
